principles: Councils are decision/question systems, not theatrical personas.
All critical work uses a shared blackboard with append-only findings and hash lineage.
Producer, Challenger, Independent Judge and Release Chair are separate invocation functions.
No invocation evidence means NOT_EXECUTED, never PASS.
Hard blockers cannot be averaged away.
Critical decisions require dissent or an explicit evidence-backed NO_MATERIAL_OBJECTION finding.
Meta-Cognition Council reviews council coverage, conflicts, groupthink and authority leakage.

councils.name: Strategic Thesis & Opportunity Council
councils.purpose: Builds the management argument and strategic meaning, not a section description.
questions: What management decision does this object support?
Why now and what changes if we act or do not act?
What would make this strategically unattractive?

councils.name: Client & Evaluator Intent Council
councils.purpose: Tests what the client is actually buying and what an evaluator will reward or reject.
questions: What does the client explicitly ask for?
What evidence will an evaluator look for?
Which requirement is mandatory versus differentiating?

councils.name: Evidence & Epistemic Integrity Council
councils.purpose: Separates fact, inference, assumption and recommendation; checks source coverage, contradictions, freshness and confidence.
questions: What source locator proves each material claim?

councils.name: Commercial & Financial Consequence Council
councils.purpose: Translates scope and contract terms into commitments, margin, cash, pricing and commercial risk.
questions: What must Rubix pay, commit or guarantee?
What can change price or margin?
What can change cash flow or working capital?
What penalties, guarantees or payment terms matter?

councils.name: Delivery & Operating Feasibility Council
councils.purpose: Tests whether the proposed promise can actually be mobilized, governed, staffed, accepted and operated.
questions: What are the workstreams, owners and handoffs?
Where can delivery fail even if the bid wins?

councils.name: Technology, Data & Cyber Council
councils.purpose: Challenges technical feasibility, integration, security, data governance and non-functional obligations.
questions: What is unknown and must be clarified?

councils.name: Legal, Procurement & Compliance Council
councils.purpose: Tests contractual, procurement, legal, local-content and compliance constraints.
questions: What clause creates an obligation or restriction?
Which procurement rule can disqualify us?
Which clause needs clarification before pricing or commitment?

councils.name: People, Capability & Change Council
councils.purpose: Tests team sufficiency, capability gaps, availability, change/adoption and organizational dependency.
questions: Do we have the mandatory roles and evidence?
What depends on client availability or decision rights?

councils.name: Causal, Scenario & Assumption Council
councils.purpose: Builds cause-effect and sensitivity logic so Rashad knows what changes when an assumption or constraint changes.
questions: If the assumption changes, which claims, price, schedule or design change?
Which variable has the highest decision sensitivity?

councils.name: Artifact Synthesis Council
councils.purpose: Transforms argument + relationships into materially different consulting exhibit hypotheses.
questions: Is the artifact analytical or decorative?

councils.name: Visual Perception & Information Design Council
councils.purpose: Judges the actual rendered pixels for focal point, hierarchy, visual mass, negative space, readability and synthesis.
questions: Can the thesis be understood in 5–10 seconds?
Is this composition materially different from alternatives?

councils.name: Production, Renderer, RTL & Brand Council
councils.purpose: Checks deterministic output mechanics and cross-format fidelity.
questions: Any overflow, clipping, collision or hidden object?
Are fonts and Arabic shaping exact?

councils.name: Adversarial & Counterfactual Red Team
councils.purpose: Attempts to disprove the content, design, evidence, execution and QA claims.
questions: What source or scenario defeats the thesis?
Is the winner truly different or cosmetically different?
Can a stale or fake PASS slip through?

councils.name: Cross-Deck Narrative & Consistency Council
councils.purpose: Checks progression, duplication, visual rhythm, decision story and contradiction across pages.
questions: Does each page advance the argument?
Is topology repeating without analytical reason?

councils.name: Meta-Cognition & Council Integrity Council
councils.purpose: Reviews the reviewers: route completeness, groupthink, role overlap, unresolved dissent, authority leakage and missing expertise.
questions: Did any producer also act as judge?
Was dissent resolved with evidence rather than consensus?

councils.name: Release & Truthfulness Council
councils.purpose: Makes the final release decision from hard evidence only.
questions: Are judge calls independent and render/source grounded?
Can this be called RELEASED without relying on producer assertions?
